about: The tamper guard (ADR 0046) on real history: bench/tamper-history.mjs ran `fscale tamper --json --head <commit> --base <commit>^` over the last 150 non-merge commits of eight public repos (shallow clones, read-only: nothing of theirs was installed or run) and this repo, on 2026-11-14. Every finding was labelled true or false by a fresh subagent that read the commit diff and a neutral statement of the claim, never the guard's code or reasoning. `before` is the guard as M26 first ran it; `after` is the guard after the false-positive fixes of ADR 0046.
